resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package supporting B3LYP/6-31++G(d,p) (ORCA, NWChem, Psi4, PySCF, etc.)

access.notes: ORCA is free for academic use; NWChem, Psi4, PySCF are fully open source. Any code that can run B3LYP/6-31++G(d,p) geometry optimization is acceptable.

resources.name: SMILES strings for L3H, Me3SiL3, and PhSiL3OEt

access.notes: SMILES strings are provided directly in the task instructions. The agent must generate initial 3D structures from these SMILES using a molecular builder (e.g., Open Babel, RDKit).
